gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Amatic SC draws its letters in a single pencil-like line, thin and quirky, with no brush swell anywhere. Noto Sans Warang Citi sits underneath with words that pack into solid blocks, giving that scribble something sturdy to lean on.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-yi: Wiry, hand-drawn, a bit wonky. Noto Sans Yi has a deep midsection in its lowercase and rounds left unsealed, so a long paragraph in this sans moves along smoothly beneath the wire-thin heading.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-squ: Scrappy and rounded, like bent wire. Amatic SC feels homemade beside Noto Sans Zanabazar Square, whose soaring x-height and wide gaps make it crisp and friendly, so the two seem like a sketchbook sitting next to a tidy notice.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Loose, rustic and a little cheeky. Amatic SC is best at casual, pen-drawn attitude, while Noto Traditional Nushu, a broad-nibbed sans with bowls that fill the line, is best at staying approachable.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-numans: Quirky, with a pencil's steady line. Numans spaces its swollen lowercase well past normal tracking, so a long stretch of this plain sans reads slowly and openly, like beads on a string.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-onest: Onest reads gently, with short ascenders over big bowls. Amatic SC lends it a hand-drawn, toothpaste-squeezed headline, and that scribbled top set against the smooth sans-serif below gives the page its personality.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-open-sans: Hand-drawn and a bit wiry, like ballpoint lines. Its pressure-free stroke stands out against Open Sans, a smooth sans-serif with bulky lowercase and no clogged curves, which makes the strongest single quality of the pair its mix of casual and clear.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-orienta: Quirky, then. Amatic SC is all constant-ink stripes. Orienta, a modern sans-serif with breathing counters and little height difference between cases, would carry a long passage in an unhurried, tidy way.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-parkinsans: Contemporary at heart, Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness throughout and stays crisp when shrunk. And through a long passage, its lowercase rising close to the capitals gives it a steady, even march beneath Amatic SC.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-pathway-extreme: Rustic from the first glance, Amatic SC has a lowercase a with no thin hairlines at all, just a squeezed line. Pathway Extreme, a sans with big x-height, reads easily over long text.
